verdict.rationale: Hightouch's docs say Customer Studio builds traits and audiences on top of the warehouse identity layer, which gives thin first-party support for computed traits feeding targeting. There is no evidence of predictive scores such as LTV, churn or purchase propensity. AI Decisioning recommends message, channel and timing, which is a different capability and is not credited. Missing for 10: documented predictive scoring (LTV/churn/propensity), detail on how computed traits are defined and calculated on profiles, explicit use of traits in audience filters, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, computed traits and predictive scores (LTV, churn or purchase propensity) are calculated on profiles and usable in targeting

citations.quote: Customer Studio builds traits and audiences on top.
Once the schema is configured, marketers can build audiences and journeys in a no-code UI.
